# coval_run_templates (Data Source)

Lists Coval run templates visible to the configured API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_run_templates" "regression" {
  tag_filters = ["regression"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tag_filters` (Set of String) Optional tags that every returned run template must have.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `run_templates` (Attributes List) All matching run-template summaries. Use the singular coval_run_template data source to retrieve metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--run_templates))

<a id="nestedatt--run_templates"></a>
